name: MemoryManager
description: FreeInk on-demand memory/cache reclaim: a priority-ordered registry of evictable cache sinks plus heap reporting, over the ESP-IDF heap-capabilities allocator. Consumers register rebuildable RAM caches (rendered pages, glyphs, decoded images, PSRAM pools) and call clearCaches()/boost() to free RAM on demand or under pressure. Also provides soft/hard heap-pressure watermarks, borrowable static task-stack slots for transient big-stack tasks, fixed bump arenas, and a reboot-flavored boost.
keywords: memory, heap, cache, psram, reclaim, boost, watermark, arena, task-stack
